Mr. Jay R. Shah, learned advocate waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the for the respondent no.2 - original complainant.

2. By this application under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the applicant-original accused seeks to invoke the inherent powers of this Court praying for quashing of the proceedings of the Criminal Case No.299 of 2017 pending before the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Tarapur arising out from the FIR being C.R. No.I-39 of 2016 registered with Tarapur Police Station, Anand for the offence punishable under Sections-406, 420, 409, 467, 468,
469, 471 and 120B of I.P.C.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/5258/2025 ORDER DATED: 09/04/2025 undefined 3.
Heard learned advocates appearing for the respective parties.

sentences.text: 4. Mr. Jinesh Kapadia, learned advocate appearing for the applicant submits that the present applicant is the inspector in the APMC, whereas, the accused persons nos.3 to 14 are the commission agent and working with the Agricultural Produce Market Committee, Tarapur, District Anand and for that purpose, they were holding valid license and they were working in the said capacity since last many years.

On 03.05.2016, one FIR has been registered by the respondent No.2 vide C.R.No.I-39 of 2016 at Tarapur Police Station, District Anand for the offences punishable under Sections 409, 467, 468, 469, 471, 406, 420 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code against the accused persons including the applicant herein.

It is alleged in the FIR that the accused persons have made hand-in-glove with the present applicant herein and accused No.1 and thereby, they have committed irregularities as regards the market fees and weighing fees and produced the fake bills in the APMC,
Tarapur by portraying them as original one and thereby misappropriated an amount of Rs.3,01,033/-.
On the strength of registration of the FIR, investigation was carried out and ultimately at the end of the day, charge-sheet has been filed against all the accused persons.
Learned advocate submits that in fact applicant being the inspector, has detected the illegalities and get the amount recovered.

In fact the deficient amount mentioned in the FIR has already been deposited by the concerned commission agent before the NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/5258/2025 ORDER DATED: 09/04/2025 undefined submission of the charge-sheet.

Learned advocate further submits that the dispute is amicably settled between the parties and a meeting was convened by the Chairman and Members of the APMC, Tarapur, wherein, decision was taken to withdraw the proceedings instituted against the applicant herein.

Learned advocate further submits that respondent No.2 - original complainant has also filed affidavits interalia stating that if the FIR, charge-sheet and consequential proceedings arising out of the said FIR are quashed and set aside, in that event, he has no objection.
An affidavit to that effect has also been filed by the complainant.

It is, therefore,
urged that the present applications may be allowed.

5. Learned advocate Mr. Jay R. Shah, for the respondent no.2 - original complainant has submitted that the respondent no.2 - complainant has personally remained present before this court and he has no objection, if the proceedings qua the present applicant would be quashed.
Learned advocate further submits that the disputes is settled between the parties and an affidavit in that regard is already filed by the complainant.

Learned advocate has identified the signature of the complainant as well as identified the respondent no.2 - original complainant, who is personally present before this Court and also confirmed correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed by him.
6. Learned APP has submitted that appropriate order may be passed on the strength of the settlement arrived at between the parties.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/5258/2025 ORDER DATED: 09/04/2025 undefined 7.

Therefore, since now, the dispute with reference to the impugned FIR is settled and resolved by and between parties, which is confirmed by the original complainant through his learned advocate,
the trial would be futile and any further continuation of proceedings would amount to abuse of process of law.
Therefore, the impugned FIR is required to be quashed and set aside.

The affidavit Ajitbhai Jadavbhai Gohel vs State Of Gujarat on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160699970/
2 filed by the respondent no.2- original complainant is ordered to be taken on record.

sentences.text: 8. Resultantly, the present application is allowed.

The proceedings of the Criminal Case No.299 of 2017 pending before the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Tarapur arising out from the FIR being C.R. No.I-39 of 2016 registered with Tarapur Police Station, Anand and all other consequential proceedings arising out of said complaint are hereby quashed and set aside qua the applicant herein.
The Registry shall accept the vakalatnama of Mr. Jay R. Shah, the learned advocate who appeared on behalf of the respondent no.2-original first informant.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.
